subject: Order form commercial details: billing entity, commits, and tax routing
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <procurement@neptunelabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Neptune Labs PO & billing entity question

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was pleased. Attached is our standard PO (Neptune_PO_4209.pdf). Before we execute, procurement needs confirmation on which Redwood legal entity will issue invoices (US vs EU), the net terms, and whether VAT will be grossed-up or reverse-charged.

A couple quick asks so we can route the PO on our side:
- Confirm invoice payee name + remit address that should appear on the PO/Invoice.
- Confirm Net terms we should expect on invoices (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60).
- Any required tax docs (W-9 / VAT certificate) we should attach to the PO packet.

If easier, we can accept a signed order form + PO combo — let me know the path and I’ll push through procurement.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Nguyen
Sr. Procurement Manager | Neptune Labs
[Attachment: Neptune_PO_4209.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <procurement@neptunelabs.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Neptune Labs PO & billing entity question

Folks — looping you in on Neptune's PO. Key asks from procurement (see Sara's note): invoice entity, net terms, and tax handling. I attached the current OrderForm_Draft_v1.pdf to this thread for internal redlines.

My initial read / proposal:
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference US, Inc. for initial contract (Neptune is US-headquartered). If they request EU invoicing for VAT purposes, we can offer Redwood Inference EU BV but will need tax-evidence (VAT cert).
- Net terms: propose Net 45 (standard for this segment). Offer 1% discount for Net 30 if procurement pushes for faster terms.
- VAT: for US invoices we do not collect VAT; if they require EU invoicing, Finance needs either reverse-charge confirmation or a local VAT reg number.

Asks: Kimberly — can you confirm whether Finance is comfortable with the proposed Net 45 + optional early-pay discount and whether we should accept the PO as-is as an authorization to bill? Marcus / Karthik — pricing appendix will need a minor update if we accept a ramped minimum commit (we proposed a 3-month ramp: 50% / 75% / 100% of first-year commit).

Thanks — I’ll coordinate external response once we have alignment.

Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: OrderForm_Draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Neptune Labs PO & billing entity question

Thanks for the heads-up, Jasmine. A few finance/legal constraints and documentation requests: 

1) Invoice entity: Finance prefers Redwood Inference US, Inc. for US customers to avoid cross-entity recognition issues. If Neptune needs EU invoicing for VAT reasons we can make an exception but will require: 
   - Neptune's local VAT registration + certificate (EU VAT cert).
   - A signed acceptance that Redwood EU will be the invoicing party (we need the PO and signed order form naming Redwood EU BV).

2) Net terms: Net 45 is acceptable. If we offer 1% for Net 30, we need it documented in Order Form Appendix A (pricing & payment terms) and signed off by Revenue Ops.

3) Taxes: If they claim reverse-charge, we need their confirmation in writing (line on the PO referencing reverse-charge) plus the VAT cert. Absent that, Redwood will invoice without VAT (US entity), but customer is responsible for local tax.

4) PO acceptance: We can accept their PO as an acknowledgement provided the PO references our order form and contains a PO number. Please confirm whether Neptune will provide a PO number (Sara?).

I’ve uploaded a quick checklist to the shared Drive for the legal/finance packet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-orderform.

Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Neptune Labs PO & billing entity question

Quick commercial inputs from the sales side:

- Commit ramp: I support Jasmine's 3-month ramp (50% / 75% / 100%) for first-year minimums — it helps procurement sign earlier. We should capture the ramp explicitly in the Order Form pricing table and call out the monthly invoice calculation method (pro-rata on usage or minimum, whichever is greater).

- Pricing appendix: Attached Pricing_Appendix_v2.xlsx with suggested cells to update (row comments). If Finance signs off on Net 45, we keep standard pricing. If they push for Net 30 + 1% discount, mark up final ARR model to reflect the discount.

- Invoicing flow: Request Neptune include PO number and designate the invoice remit address. Also confirm whether they require an invoice to go to AP@neptunelabs.com or to a department-specific address.

I’ll be prepared to send an updated Order Form (with ramp and payment adjustments) to Sara once Kimberly confirms acceptance.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Commercials | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Pricing_Appendix_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <procurement@neptunelabs.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@neptunelabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Neptune Labs PO & billing entity question

Hi Sara / Daniel — thanks for the PO. Quick summary and next steps so procurement can proceed: 

- Billing entity: Redwood Inference US, Inc. unless Neptune confirms need for EU invoicing and uploads EU VAT cert (then we can use Redwood Inference EU BV).
- Net terms: We propose Net 45. If you prefer Net 30 we can offer 1% early-pay discount (please confirm in writing so we can reflect in the order form).
- Commit ramp: We propose a 3-month ramp for the first-year minimums (50% / 75% / 100%). We will reflect this in the Order Form pricing table.
- PO number: Please confirm the PO number and remit address to appear on invoices. We cannot accept the PO without a PO number.
- Tax docs: If Neptune intends to apply reverse-charge or needs EU invoicing please attach the VAT certificate to the PO packet. For US invoicing, provide the PO + remit details and we’ll proceed.

I’ve attached the updated OrderForm_Draft_v1 (internal redlines) and Pricing_Appendix_v2. Once you confirm PO number and whether you’ll attach VAT evidence (if applicable) we’ll generate a final order form and a DocuSign link for signatures.

DocuSign preview: https://docusign.net/DocuSign/embeddedSigning?d=abc123
Shared checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-orderform

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
